rows.note: 3 per Corpus-reward Invasion, or Vox Solaris bounty rotation
rows.alt: or craft from Fieldron Samples, 12h each

conditions: Check the star chart every session for a Corpus-reward Invasion; each gives 3 Fieldron for about 15 minutes of play.
bonuses: Orb Vallis bounties rotate Fieldron, Mutagen Mass and Detonite Injector rewards; one player reported 8 Fieldron from a single bounty, and you earn Vox Solaris standing at the same time.
If you build them instead, buy a stack of Fieldron blueprints at once and restart builds from the companion app so the queue runs while you're offline.

disclosures.title: crafting from scratch
disclosures.body: Each Fieldron needs its own single-use blueprint (15,000 credits) plus 15,000 credits, 10 Fieldron Samples, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage and 250 Plastids, 12h to build. For all 8: 80 Fieldron Samples, 8 Control Modules, 4,000 Salvage, 2,000 Plastids and about 240,000 credits. Fieldron Samples drop from Corpus enemies and containers on Venus, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune and Pluto. Rushing a Fieldron costs more platinum than a finished Amprex sells for on the Market; it's never worth it.

conditions: Argon decays: half of it, rounded down, disappears at 00:00 GMT, so farm it last, once all 8 Fieldron are built or queued to finish.
bonuses: Max-range Xaku or Limbo: finish the objective, then cast Xaku's 4 or Limbo's Cataclysm in every room to break containers and nodes from range through walls; most runs give 1-4 in a few minutes, and Argon shows on the minimap.

Alternative: Mot or Ani Survival with a loot frame (Nekros, Khora with Pilfering Strangledome, Hydroid with Pilfering Swarm), public, 5-10 minutes; Steel Path and a Smeeta Kavat's Charm stack with this.
Run Void fissures while farming Argon to open relics at the same time.
